svg.text: High-Level Multichannel Customer Support Platform with Multi-Tenant RAG & Human-in-the-Loop AI Architecture (BSc IT Final Year Project)
🛡️ HAQDESK AI SYSTEM BOUNDARY (MULTI-TENANT ISOLATED CORE)

g.text: Tenant setup, Channel OAuth, Team RBAC, Knowledge upload, Mode config
Unified inbox workspace, AI draft review/edit/send, Customer management, Internal chat
Interacts natively via Facebook, Instagram, or Gmail (No HaqDesk login required)
1. PRESENTATION LAYER (Next.js 15 • TypeScript • React • Tailwind CSS)
2. APPLICATION & BACKEND LAYER (FastAPI • Python 3.13 • Uvicorn ASGI)
Asynchronous Micro-Service Architecture with Tenant Security Boundaries
3. AI & RAG ORCHESTRATION LAYER (Multilingual RAG • NLP • Multi-Model Gateway)
Dynamic Multilingual Normalization, Vector Retrieval & Fallback Gateway
4. DATA & STORAGE LAYER (Relational Database • Dedicated Vector Store • File Storage)
Strict Multi-Tenant Row & Vector Collection Isolation
Core Entities: businesses (tenant config, mode: auto/review), users (credentials, roles: admin/agent), invitations
Messaging Entities: customers (profiles, tags), customer_identities (cross-platform IDs), conversations, messages
Integrations & Knowledge: integrations (encrypted credentials, page IDs), knowledge_documents, knowledge_chunks
🔒 Security: Every query strictly filtered by authenticated user's business_id (Multi-Tenant Isolation)
Payload Metadata: {business_id, document_id, chunk_id, content, page_number, filename}
🔒 Strict Tenant Cosine Similarity Filter on Search

svg.text: Fully integrated & verified in current testbed
• Inbound: Meta Webhook Event (via ngrok public tunnel)
• Outbound: Meta Graph API v18.0 (/messages with Page Token)
• Inbound: Linked Facebook Page Webhook Router
• Outbound: Meta Graph API v18.0 (/messages with Instagram ID)
• Auth: Encrypted Google App Passwords / OAuth2
* Architectural design ready; requires business verification
• Cloud API webhook schema implemented in codebase
• Requires Meta Business Verification & Official Phone Number
• Webhook Connector SDK (Custom Web Chat / Mobile Apps)

g.text: • High context window & complex reasoning fallback
• Dynamic routing across global AI inference APIs
• Local Models: gemma3:1b, llama3.2:3b via http://localhost:11434
🔄 LiteLLM Failover: Auto-switches provider upon 429 Rate-Limit / 503 Outage
